challenges.says: Criteria 1-3 restate businessrule-47036476815425257305 (heading and blank line only when "Include SPOL header" is ticked, listed under the step's keeps) yet every criterion has "from": [], so the rule is uncited and no criterion says why.

Criterion 5 invents behaviour: the code only focuses and selects the text when the dialog is shown (InspectSpolFragment.vb:30-33), while Copy merely selects all and copies (lines 26-29), so focus on Copy is not stated by any rule.

Criteria 4 and 5 split one Copy action, and 5 ('ready to use') is vague; the dialog-open selection and the Ctrl+A select-all that the code does (lines 30-33, 44-46) are not stated as such, and the 'what' claims all settings are shown without any rule or criterion backing it.
